name: Stochastic Tomography
aliases: random walk algorithm for tomographic reconstruction
definition: A matrix-free stochastic solver for tomography that minimizes a convex objective function F by representing the volume estimate as a set of discrete samples {xk} with density proportional to the volume, using a random walk to explore the space and reduce residuals.
summary: Stochastic Tomography is a matrix-free, grid-free iterative solver that represents volumes as discrete samples to avoid spatial discretization artifacts.
